description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy performance of three different models – Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni – on two different data types: Audio and Noise, as well as an overall average. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percent, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, and tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. For each model, there are three bars: a blue bar representing “Audio”, a purple bar representing “Noise”, and a gray dashed bar representing the average. The Qwen2-Audio-Instruct model has an Audio accuracy of approximately 24%, a Noise accuracy of approximately 29%, and an average accuracy of approximately 26.5%. The Audio-Reasoner model shows an Audio accuracy of around 44%, a Noise accuracy of approximately 32%, and an average accuracy of approximately 38%. Finally, the Qwen-2.5-Omni model has an Audio accuracy of approximately 57%, a Noise accuracy of around 33%, and an average accuracy of approximately 45%. The bars are grouped by model, with the Audio, Noise, and average bars positioned adjacent to each other for each model. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
